title: Cirql Protocol
tagline: Cirql Protocol: A decentralized finance solution using ERC-4626 vaults, enabling users to fund and acquire shares while facilitating credit delegation for efficient borrowing. Integrated with GHO stablecoin for optimal lending strategies.
description:
Cirql Protocol Overview:

Project Objective:
Cirql Protocol aims to revolutionize decentralized finance (DeFi) through the implementation of ERC-4626 vaults, empowering users to participate in yield-bearing strategies, credit delegation, and seamless integration with the GHO stablecoin.

1. Vault Participation: Alice funds an ERC-4626 vault, acquiring shares in a selected yield-bearing strategy.
2. Credit Delegation: Seeking additional yield, Alice delegates borrowing power securely to Bob through on-chain smart contracts.
3. GHO Stablecoin Strategies: Alice optimizes lending activities by leveraging the ERC-4626 wrapper for GHO stablecoin borrowing.
4. Monitoring and Adjustments: She regularly adjusts her portfolio based on market conditions or personal preferences.

Usecases:
ERC-4626 Vaults: Users can fund ERC-4626 vaults, acquiring shares representing a single underlying ERC-20 token, optimizing and unifying technical parameters for yield-bearing strategies.

Credit Delegation: Cirql facilitates credit delegation, allowing depositors to earn interest while delegating borrowing power to other users. This innovative feature supports uncollateralized loans through on-chain smart contracts or off-chain legal agreements.

GHO Stablecoin Integration: Cirql serves as an ERC-4626 wrapper for GHO stablecoin borrowing, providing users with efficient access to decentralized, overcollateralized, and configurable stable assets.

Key Features:
Vault Contract: A robust vault contract facilitates ERC-4626-based strategies, streamlining the process for users to deposit, withdraw, and monitor balances of tokenized yield-bearing vaults.

Credit Delegation Agreements: Cirql enables users to delegate borrowing power securely, with terms agreed upon either off-chain through legal agreements or on-chain via smart contracts.

GHO Borrowing Strategies: Integration with GHO stablecoin allows users to utilize the ERC-4626 wrapper for optimized borrowing and lending strategies, contributing to a more stable and reliable DeFi ecosystem.

Future Scopes:
Extended Yield Strategies: Continuous development to enhance yield-bearing vault strategies, providing users with diversified and efficient options for optimizing their crypto holdings.

Expanded Credit Delegation: Cirql aims to broaden the scope of credit delegation, exploring partnerships and collaborations to offer a wider range of borrowing opportunities for the community.

Community Governance: Implementing community-driven governance to involve stakeholders in decision-making processes, ensuring the protocol evolves in line with the users' needs and preferences.

Cirql Protocol envisions a decentralized financial landscape where users can seamlessly engage in yield-bearing activities, delegate credit, and harness the potential of stablecoin strategies for sustained growth and innovation within the DeFi space.
how_its_made:
The project uses the following technologies.
1. ConnectKit by Family for wallet connections. 
2. ERC-4626 Standard: Usage: Cirql Protocol integrates ERC-4626 for optimizing and unifying the technical parameters of yield-bearing vaults.
Properties: ERC-4626 outlines a standard API for tokenized yield-bearing vaults representing shares of an underlying ERC-20 token.
3. GHO token + GHODebt token to track borrows and repayment. 
4. AaveV3 Pool - To mint GHO(stablecoin) for borrowers.
5. ERC20: actions on vault shares and underlying asset controls. 

Something hacky to notice: The project started as a farcaster bot service to enable p2p lending and borrowing powered by the bot's managed vault. Due to the scope of the hackathon and timeline I had to pivot to becoming the protocol we are right now xD
